verdict.rationale: The official docs show code written against a first-party client object: `client.runs.create(...)` to start runs and `runs.events()` to poll events with a cursor. The GitHub README also points developers to an official Python library for automating from their own code. Together these show official SDK-style access to both the Cloud API and the local agent. Missing for 10: explicit naming of the SDK packages and their install or reference docs, the range of supported languages (only Python is evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
